restoration_note: Teaching 45 describes the Lord (Father of Life) sending his operative power downward into the natural mind in three accommodations — wind/perception, water/truth, fire/love — and then drawing them up again so that what cannot be conjoined is cast beyond the cosmos. The text is highly formulaic, with parallel passages for each of the three purifications, and editor restorations are mostly orthographic completions of words that recur multiple times in the same teaching. I accepted virtually all editor proposals where they were short (1-3 letters) completions of certainly-readable words (ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲟⲣⲉ, ⲁⲃⲁⲗ, ⲱⲏⲛ, ⲡⲉⲧⲟⲓⲭⲉⲓⲟⲛ, ⲡⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ, etc.). For mid-sized gaps where parallel passages constrained the form (e.g. {39}-{40} 'water of Error', {50} 'after the water', {51} 'at that very hour') I proposed with moderate confidence based on formula. Larger lacunae without traces ({13}-{15}, {24}, {26}, {27}, {28}, {30}, {41}, {48}, {49}, {52}, {53}, {54}) I left unrestorable: the formulaic register suggests their content but does not constrain it tightly enough.

Completes ⲁⲛⲟⲩⲧⲟⲡⲟⲥ 'to a place' (Greek τόπος); editor proposal accepted.
Completes ⲉⲧⲃⲉ 'concerning' — the heading-formula recurs at section 2618 and is here introducing the chapter on the Mighty Ones.
Completes ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲓⲟⲟⲣⲉ 'Mighty Ones / strongholds'; editor proposal accepted.
Genitive ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ joining ⲡⲓⲱⲧ (end of prior segment) to ⲡⲱⲛⲍ̄: 'the Father of Life,' the title that frames the whole teaching.
Completes ⲁϣⲟⲩⲟ 'about to pour out'; editor proposal accepted.
Completes ϣⲟⲩⲱⲙ 'ate' — the verb governs this whole sentence and recurs in 2594, 2588.
Completes ⲧⲟⲧⲉ 'then' — the temporal connector beginning the next narrative step.
Completes ⲧϣⲁⲙⲧⲉ 'three' (Lyc fem.), continuing 'the three garments' enumerated in this segment.
Completes ⲁⲭⲛ̄ (= Sahidic ⲉϫⲛ̄) 'upon' across the line break; ⲁ- visible at end of preceding line.
Relative pronoun + relative converter producing 'those which he established'; ⲧⲁϥⲥⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩ following requires the relative converter ⲉ-. Length ~5 chars including space fits.
Completes ⲥⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩ 'established them' (verb ⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ with 3pl suffix); editor proposal accepted.
Completes ⲧⲟⲓⲛⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ 'the founding/establishment' (action-noun on ⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ); editor proposal accepted.
10 chars without traces; opens a clause whose content (probably the names of the three or a verb of dispatching) cannot be recovered safely.
5 chars after ⲛ̄ⲛ-; could be a noun in genitive (e.g. ⲛ̄ⲛ-ⲙⲁⲛ-, ⲛ̄ⲛ-ⲕⲁϩ) but no parallel constrains it.
3 chars after ⲁⲩⲕ-; possibly a verb of putting/throwing but cannot be specified from traces.

Completes ⲛⲕⲱⲧⲉ 'encompassing-circuits' (lexicon entry for ⲕⲱⲧⲉ); the dark mountain stands in the surrounding circuits of the side-of-radiance.
Completes ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙⲙⲁϥ 'forth from him' — standard directional formula; ⲁⲃ- visible.
'The preparation' — recurs in lines 20, 22, 29 as the technical term for what is set down at the cosmic perimeter.
Conjunctive prefix ⲛ̄ⲥⲉ- producing ⲛ̄ⲥⲉⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ 'and they manifest'; editor proposal accepted.
9 chars without traces at end of clause about mountains and slopes; could be a relative clause or directional, but no formula fixes it.
Completes ⲱⲏⲛ 'tree' (Lyc form of ϣⲏⲛ); editor proposal accepted.
7 chars without strong constraint; the clause continues but its predicate cannot be recovered.
4 chars after ⲙⲛ 'and'; another body part (perhaps ⲡⲕⲉⲥ 'bone', ⲥⲛⲁϩ, or a faculty) — too many candidates.
30 chars rubbed off; full clause not recoverable.

5 chars connecting 'above the earths' to 'purification'; possible candidates ⲛⲥⲉⲣ̄, ⲁⲡⲟⲩ, ⲉⲩⲣ̄ but none secure.

Directional 'inward' continuing the gathering action; editor proposal accepted.
5 chars, no constraint; could be ⲁⲡⲙⲁ 'to the place' but the line is too damaged for confidence.
14 chars after a single ⲧ; cannot be reconstructed.
Parallel to 2641 ⲙⲛⲛⲥⲁ ⲧⲙⲁⲩ 'after the water': here 'after the water, the fire was poured out' completes the threefold sequence (water → darkness → fire). 6 chars fits est 7.
Completes the temporal formula ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲛⲉⲩ ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ 'at that very hour'; editor proposal accepted.
20 chars rubbed off after ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ 'illuminators'; content (probably a relative clause about the path of the sun and moon) not recoverable.
3 chars before ⲏ; final letters of preceding clause cannot be reconstructed.
7 chars after the listing 'fire and Darkness and water'; could be a directional or relative ⲉⲧⲙ̄ⲙⲉⲩ but not constrained enough.

Three clustered lacunae preceding 'no one remained'; content cannot be reconstructed.
9-char lacuna at end of clause about mountains and slopes; not recoverable.
7-char lacuna continuing the clause about barren places; not recoverable.
Second member of an enumeration paired with 'limb' (μέλος); could be 'bone' or another bodily/structural term, but not constrained.
30-char rubbed-off span; opens a new clause about the barren places — content not recoverable.
